 There have been personnel changes in the Dynamo coaching staff
 Sports 
 23:00, yesterday 
 AI translation 
 The Dynamo Kyiv coaching staff has been expanded with two Polish specialists – Daniel Wojtasz and Grzegorz Wojtkowiak. They will assist acting head coach Maciej Kędzierek in working with the first team. 
 This was reported by the official website of Dynamo Kyiv.
 The club announced personnel changes less than a week after dismissing Igor Kostyuk as head coach.
 Daniel Wojtas holds a UEFA PRO coaching license and has been working in football since 2009. In 2024, he served as the chief analyst for the Polish national team, and later worked as an assistant coach at Legia Warsaw and Radomyak.
 Wojtasz also served on the coaching staffs of a number of Polish clubs, including Stal, Korona, Polonia, Odra and Zaglebie. He also managed Skra Częstochowa.
 Kędziorek’s second new assistant, Grzegorz Wojtkowiak, previously played for the Polish national team and became the national champion as part of Lech Poznań.
 After ending his playing career in 2021, he remained at Lech Poznań. He first helped coach the U19 team, and later became its manager.
 From January to May 2024, Wojtkowiak worked as an assistant head coach of the Lech main team. Later, he headed the reserve team, with which he worked until April 2026.
